results.claim: In the phase 3 TROPION-Lung01 trial, datopotamab deruxtecan (Dato-DXd) significantly improved overall survival compared with docetaxel in patients with previously treated advanced/metastatic non-small cell lung cancer.

Navacaprant, a highly selective kappa-opioid receptor antagonist dosed at 80 mg once daily, produces a statistically significant reduction in HAMD-17 depression score versus placebo at week 8 as the primary endpoint in adults with major depressive disorder.

In patients with uncontrolled or treatment-resistant hypertension, adding the aldosterone synthase inhibitor baxdrostat lowers seated systolic blood pressure by roughly 9-10 mm Hg more than placebo at 12 weeks.
